import subprocess

# Test 1: research with cache=True on cyclic structure - should not raise RecursionError
code = r'''
from boltons.iterutils import research

a = [1]
a.append(a)
result = research(a, query=lambda p, k, v: False, cache=True)
print("Result:", result)
print("PASS: No RecursionError with cache=True")
'''
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-c', code], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
print(result.stdout)
